chapter.verse: Nipikal ni masani, khuavak tuungin tua numeite amau' bawlkholhsa zanamtuite tawi-in hankhuk ah pai uh hi.
Tua ciangin hankhuk hukna suangtum kilikkhia khina om mu uh a,
ahih hangin a sung a lut uhleh Topa Jesu' luang mu lo uh hi.
Tua hangin lamdang sa-in a om laitakun, en un, amau' gei-ah puantual a te dialdial a silh mi nih hong ding uh hi.
Amaute lau lua-in a mai uh nuailam leilak a ngat laitakun tua mite in, "Bang hangin a site lakah a nungta va zong na hi uh hiam?
Amah thokik khinzo hi! Hih takah om nawnlo hi. Galilee a om lai-a hong gen,
mawhnei mite' kiangah Mihing' Tapa lehhek thuakin khailup thuakin ni thum ciangin thokik ding, a cih thu phawk un," ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Jesu' thugente phawkkik uh a,
hankhuk pan a ciah uh ciangin hih thute a vekin sawmlekhatte' tung leh a dang teng' tungah gen uh hi.
Hih thu teng sawltakte' kiangah a va gen pen Magdala khuami Mary, Joanna, James' nu Mary leh amau tawh a tonkhawm numei dang teng ahi uh hi.
Himah taleh sawltakte in hih thute a haivai thu khatin la-in um lo uh hi.
Ahih hangin Peter dingto-in hankhuk ah va tai a, kunsukin a sung a et leh puannel dialte bek a om mu a, thupiangte lamdang sa kawmin inn ah ciah hi.
Tua ni mahin nungzuite mi nih Jerusalem pan tai sagih b kiim a gamla Emmaus a kici khua khat ah pai uh hi.
Amaute gel kiho-in hih a piang khinsa thute khempeuh kikum uh hi.
Tua bangin kigenin a kikup laitakun Jesu mahmah in va nai-in amau tawh tonkhawm hi.
Ahih hangin tua mite a mittang uh kiliahin Jesu ahihlam thei lo uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Lampai kawma na kikup tangtang uh bang thu ahi hiam?" ci-in dong hi. Tua mite zong dinkhawlin dahmai pua uh hi.
Tua ciangin nih lakpan Cleopas a kici mipa in dawng a, "Jerusalem a va hawhte lakah tu sawnga thupiangte a theilo nang bek na hiding hi," ci hi.
"Bangci thu ahi hiam?" ci-in Jesu in a dot ciangin tuate in, "Nazareth khuami Jesu' thu hi. Amah pen Pasian leh mi khempeuh' mai-ah nasep leh thugen a cingtaak kamsang khat hi a,
sih thukhenna a thuak dingin leh khailup dingin i siampi liante leh i uliante in ap uh hi.
Himah taleh amah pen Israel mite hong tankhia dingpa ci-in ka lamet uh ahi hi. Bek thamlo, tua thute a pian zawh tu-in ni thumna hita hi.
Tua banah, ko' tualsung pana numei kimkhat in lamdang hong sasak uh hi. Amaute zingsang tuungin hankhuk pai-in
Jesu' luang a muh loh uh ciangin hong ciah uh a, Jesu nungta hi a ci vanmite' kihilna muhtuamc khat a ngahna uh hong gen uh hi.
Ko kianga om mi kimkhat hankhuk a va pai uhleh numeite' gen teng lian va tuak uh a, Jesu ahihleh mukha lo uh hi," ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Aw, thu theilote! Lungsim ziakai-in kamsangte' thugen khempeuh a um hakte!
Khris pen ama' minphatna sung a lut nadingin hih bangin a thuakkhak a kul mah hilo ahi hiam?" ci hi.
A kizomin amaute' kiangah Moses leh Kamsang Laibu khempeuh-a kipan Pasian' Laibupi bup sunga ama' thu a kigelhte a khiatna gentel hi.
Tua bang teng tawh a manawh uh khua a naih uh ciangin Jesu a paisuak ding dan khatin om hi.
Ahih hangin amaute in nakpi kho uh a, "Ko' kiangah hong taam in. A hang pen tu-in nitak lam hita a, ni zong tum dektak ta hi," ci uh hi. Tua hangin Jesu zong amaute' kiangah giak dingin lut hi.
Amaute tawh ankuang a uumkhop laitak Jesu in anlum la-in thupha pia a, balnenin amaute pia hi.
Tua ciangin amaute a mit uh kihongin Jesu ahihlam thei uh hi. Tua lianleh amau' muhna pan Jesu mang vat hi.
Amaute kiho uh a, "Lamkal ah amah tawh i kiho laitak Pasian' Laibupi a khiatna hong lahkhiat ciangin i lungsim nakpi hong phawng hilo ahi hiam?" kici uh hi.
Tua hangin amaute nih tua hunlenai mahin dingto uh a, Jerusalem ah kilehkik uh hi. Sawmlekhatte leh a lawmte khawlkhawmin a om va tuak uh a,
tuate in, "Topa thokik taktak hi. Simon' kiangah kihil khinzo hi," ci uh hi.
Amau zong lamkal-a thupiang teng leh anlum balnenna pan Jesu ahihlam a theihna uh thute gen uh hi.
Hih thute a kigen laitakun amaute' lakah Jesu mahmah hong dingin amaute' kiangah, "Nopna lemna ngah ta un!" ci hi.
Ahih hangin sikha a mu kisa uh ahih manin amaute dipkua-in patau uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Bang hangin lungbuai na hi uh hiam? Bang hangin na lungsim sung uhah muanlahna piang ahi hiam?
Ka khut ka khete en dih un. Keimah ka hi hi. Hong lawng unla en un. Sikha in tu-a ka neih nong muh bangun cilesa leh guhletang nei lo hi," ci hi.
Tua bangin a gen khit ciangin amaute' kiangah a khut a khete lak hi.
Amau zong nuam luatna tawh um zo nailo uh a, lamdang sa-in a om laitakun Jesu in, "Hih takah nektheih khatpeuh na nei uh hiam?" ci-in dong hi.
Amau zong ngasa-em tum khat pia uh a,
Jesu in sangin amau' muhin ne hi.

Tua ciangin amaute' kiangah, "Note tawh kong omkhop lai-a kong gen thute hih bang hi: Moses' Thukhun Laibu, Kamsang Laibu leh Phatna Late sunga keima' thu a kigelhte a vekin tangtung hamtang ding hi," ci hi.
A kizomin Pasian' Laibupi a tel theih nadingun a lungsim uh honsak hi.
Tua ciangin amaute' kiangah hih bangin gen hi: "Tua hi a, a kigelh thu ahihleh Khris pen sihna thuakin ni thum ciangin misite' lakpan thokik ding, cih thu leh
mawhmaisak nadingin kisikna thu Jerusalem pan kipanin minam khempeuh' tungah ama' min tawh kitangko ding, cih thu hi.
Note pen hih thute ah teci na hi uh hi.
En un, note' tungah ka Pa' kamciam kong puak ding hi. Ahi zongin a sangna mun pan hong pai vangliatna in note hong tuam mateng khuapi ah taam phot un."
Tua ciangin Jesu in amaute Bethany dong paikhiatpih a, a khutte laamto-in amaute thupha pia hi.
Thupha a piak laitak amaute' kiangpan Jesu kinkhia a, vantung ah amah kilato hi.
Amau zong Jesu bia-in nakpi nuamna tawh Jerusalem ah kilehkik uh a,
biakinnpi sungah Pasian phatin om tawntung uh hi.
